archetype: 3 (Pastel & Soft) mixed with hard tactile borders
rationale: For an 'Earn + Game + Chat' gamified mobile app, users need a sense of fun, high energy, and tactile feedback. A neo-brutalist approach (thick borders, offset solid shadows, vibrant pastel colors) provides that highly engaging, game-like feel (similar to Duolingo or modern Gen Z social apps). Dark mode will shift the pastels to neon/cyber accents against a deep dark indigo background.

typography.notes: Headings must never use generic system sans. Fredoka gives the app its 'game' voice. Use uppercase tracking for small labels (XP, COINS, LEVEL).

cards.interaction: Active state should compress the shadow (translate-y-1, offset 0px 0px) to simulate a physical button press.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white border-2 border-border rounded-xl py-4 px-6 font-bold text-lg text-center shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#0A0A0A] dark:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#FDFDFD]
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-white border-2 border-border rounded-xl py-4 px-6 font-bold text-lg text-center shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#0A0A0A] dark:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#FDFDFD]
buttons.outline: bg-transparent text-text border-2 border-border rounded-xl py-4 px-6 font-bold text-lg text-center

bottom_tab_navigation.style: absolute bottom-6 left-6 right-6 bg-surface border-2 border-border rounded-full py-2 px-6 flex-row justify-between items-center

progress_bars.container: h-4 w-full bg-surface border-2 border-border rounded-full overflow-hidden

badges.style: bg-warning text-text border-2 border-border rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-black uppercase

components.testing: All interactive buttons and inputs MUST include `testID` attribute (React Native equivalent of data-testid). Example: `testID='login-submit-button'`.

authentication.layout: Centered form, massive playful logo/typography at the top.

home_dashboard.games_teaser: Horizontal scroll of available mini-games (Quiz, Spin, Tap).

mini_games.spin_wheel: Large center wheel, 'SPIN' primary CTA at bottom.
mini_games.tap_challenge: Massive central button, countdown timer at top.

leaderboard.podium: Top 3 users highlighted at the top with Trophy asset.

motion_and_interaction.press_effect: All buttons and cards MUST shrink slightly and reduce shadow offset to 0 on press to simulate physical tactility.
motion_and_interaction.screen_transitions: Slide-in from right for standard navigation, Modal slide-up for games and rewards.
motion_and_interaction.rewards_celebration: Use Lottie or Confetti for 'Level Up' and 'Daily Reward Claim' events.

tap_button.description: 3D minimalist tap button asset for the Tap Challenge mini-game.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo application. Use View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView instead of HTML tags.
Use NativeWind or Tailwind React Native styling if available, otherwise map the provided Tailwind tokens to StyleSheet objects.

The core visual identity is 'Neo-Brutalism'. This means EVERY card and button needs a thick border (borderWidth: 2, borderColor: '#0A0A0A' in light mode, '#FDFDFD' in dark mode) and a hard shadow (no blur radius).
In React Native, hard shadows are achieved via: shadowColor: '#000', shadowOffset: { width: 4, height: 4 }, shadowOpacity: 1, shadowRadius: 0, elevation: 0.
Do NOT use generic minimal tech designs. The app must feel like a game. Use the provided 3D assets heavily in the UI (e.g., place the gold_coin image next to the XP text).

Implement bottom tab navigation using @react-navigation/bottom-tabs. Style the tab bar as a floating pill (absolute position, bordered, rounded-full) rather than a full-width block attached to the screen bottom.
Ensure the application handles dark/light mode dynamically. The borders and text swap between #0A0A0A (light) and #FDFDFD (dark).
Include 'testID' attributes on all interactive elements as requested for automated testing.
Use lucide-react-native for icons. Set strokeWidth={2.5} for a chunkier, bolder look.
